questions: Has there been any change in your medication list since your last hospital visit?
preop_note_claims: Patient has a history of Hypertension, Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, and Obesity (BMI 32).

Current medications include Metformin 500mg Twice daily, Lisinopril 10mg Once daily, and Atorvastatin 20mg Once daily. Ranitidine 150mg Once daily was discontinued 6 months ago due to resolution of GERD symptoms; currently on Omeprazole 20mg once daily.
Patient has a known allergy to Penicillin (rash).
ASA-PS classification is 2, indicating a patient with mild systemic disease (Hypertension, Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, Obesity).

Airway assessment and anesthetic plan documented, including General Anesthesia with Propofol, Fentanyl, and Vecuronium; Maintenance with Sevoflurane and Remifentanil; Reversal with Neostigmine and Glycopyrrolate.
handoff_claims: Patient underwent elective Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy under General Anesthesia with Propofol, Fentanyl, and Vecuronium; maintained with Sevoflurane and Remifentanil; reversed with Neostigmine and Glycopyrrolate.
Anticipated issues in PACU may include residual opioid effects, potential for nausea/vomiting, and monitoring for signs of GERD given history and current use of Omeprazole.
Key history to convey: Hypertension, Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, Obesity, and Penicillin allergy (rash). Current medications include Metformin, Lisinopril, Atorvastatin, and Omeprazole.
distractors: History of pneumonia resolved 5 years ago
